title: Virtual Card Management: Creating Instant Virtual Cards for Your Team
summary: This document explains how to create instant virtual cards for teams: you can maintain up to $275 active virtual cards at once and create up to 30 team groups. It lists the steps on the Virtual Cards page to issue a card, which is ready in ~5 seconds, and notes immediate availability in the team’s card list.
